title: Understanding Invertibility
text: To determine if a matrix is invertible, we need to check if its determinant is non-zero. If the determinant is zero, the matrix is not invertible.

title: Matrix $X'$
text: The matrix $X'$ is formed by adding a column of ones to the original matrix $X$. This is done to account for the intercept in the linear regression model.

title: Checking Determinant
text: Calculate the determinant of $X'**T*X'$. If the determinant is non-zero, then $X'**T*X'$ is invertible.

title: Calculate $X'**T*X'$
text: Compute the product $X'**T*X'$ and find its determinant.
